acceptance_criteria.criterion: rebuildIcons() resolves the framework root path and constructs the correct file paths.
rebuildIcons() calls self::init() and echoes progress messages following existing patterns.
build() includes the icon rebuild step in the correct sequence position (after generateCSSClassesJS, before updateContextGenerateDate).
Running composer rebuild-icons in the framework produces the expected output.

summary: Added `rebuildIcons()` public static method that calls `self::init()` and `self::doRebuildIcons()`.

Added `doRebuildIcons()` that resolves the framework root via `realpath(__DIR__.'/../../../..')`, constructs the three file paths (icons.json, Icon.php, icon.js), invokes `IconBuilder::build()`, and echoes progress/error messages following the established pattern.

All 11 IconBuilder tests and 3 ComposerScripts tests pass. `composer rebuild-icons` produces '- Rebuilding icon methods... DONE.' PHPStan is clean for the touched files (single pre-existing unrelated error in FetchMany.php).

comments.note: ComposerScripts.php: No observations — code in the touched files is clean and consistent. The existing pattern (public entry-point calling init() + private do*() method) was followed exactly. Error handling via OperationResult aligns with how the OpenAPI/htaccess generators handle failures.

summary: All 4 acceptance criteria verified. rebuildIcons() / doRebuildIcons() implemented correctly with init() call and proper public/delegate pattern. File paths (icons.json, Icon.php, icon.js) resolve correctly via realpath(). Sequence in build() confirmed: generateCSSClassesJS → rebuildIcons → updateContextGenerateDate. composer rebuild-icons produces '- Rebuilding icon methods... DONE.' PHPStan clean. 3 ComposerScripts tests and 11 IconBuilder tests pass.

comments.note: doRebuildIcons() uses (string)realpath(__DIR__.'/../../../../') — if realpath() ever returned false (unlikely since the class's own directory must exist), it would silently degrade to an empty string and produce wrong paths. A defensive check or FolderInfo::factory() (as used in HCP Editor) would be more robust, but this is not a real-world failure scenario.

summary: Code review passed. rebuildIcons()/doRebuildIcons() follow the established public-entry + private-delegate pattern correctly. One fix-forward applied: replaced (string)realpath(__DIR__.'/../../../../') with rtrim(FolderInfo::factory(__DIR__.'/../../../../')->getPath(), '/') in doRebuildIcons() to align with the identical pattern used in doUpdateModuleDocumentation() in the same file. Build sequence position and composer.json script entry are correct. PHPStan confirmed clean after fix.

comments.note: doRebuildIcons(): replaced `(string)realpath(__DIR__.'/../../../../')` with `rtrim(FolderInfo::factory(__DIR__.'/../../../../')->getPath(), '/')`. The realpath() cast diverged from the established FolderInfo::factory() pattern used two methods above in doUpdateModuleDocumentation(). Behaviour is identical (both produce the same absolute path since __DIR__ is always resolvable), but the FolderInfo form is consistent with codebase conventions. PHPStan clean after change.

summary: Updated src/classes/Application/Composer/README.md: expanded the 'Integration with ComposerScripts::build()' section to document the new rebuild-icons step in the build() sequence and the standalone 'composer rebuild-icons' command.

comments.note: Updated 'Integration with ComposerScripts::build()' section to document that icon rebuilding is now wired into build() (between generateCSSClassesJS and updateContextGenerateDate) and can also be run standalone via 'composer rebuild-icons'. Described what the script does (reads icons.json, rebuilds Icon.php and icon.js).
